ev.q: COPD mortality rates among men in 1999 and 2019 and among women in 2019 were inversely related to urbanicity

COPD mortality rates among men decreased in all urban-rural categories (range = −1.9% [large central metropolitan] to −0.4% [noncore]).

notes: Design not named; surveillance/descriptive with trend inferred. AAPC/APC tests against 0 are model-term tests within joinpoint, so not listed as separate tests. Restricted-period statements ('when analysis was limited to later years') read as segment-specific APCs from the same joinpoint models, not a sensitivity re-analysis; adjusted_results false because age standardization precedes the model.
view_issues: Introduction has a stray parenthesis: '(−0.4%) areas (and in the Northeast'. Text cites Figure 1 for regional trends, but Figure 1 shows urban-rural trends only.
